acceptanceCriteria: a test feeds the bytes of a real go1.27 go test -json run of a package that fails to compile (captured, not hand-written) to native.Parse and records whether it refuses; the outcome confirms or rejects this suspicion in a build-log entry

if confirmed, build-output/build-fail events keyed by ImportPath are accepted and yield a BUILD_FAILURE problem naming the package, without weakening the duplicate-field, unknown-action or post-terminal checks
body: Suspected defect (not yet reproduced against a real go test -json stream), raised by the V1-1266 lane (PR #893, 2026-10-14). internal/testrunner/native/native.go parseGo (origin/main line ~745) returns 'Go event package missing' for any event with empty Package. Since Go 1.24, go test -json reports build output and build failures as {"ImportPath":...,"Action":"build-output"|"build-fail"} events without Package, so a real compile failure would make the whole native parse fail instead of yielding a BUILD_FAILURE problem. The only test (native_test.go:101) feeds a synthetic build-fail with Package set. Expected: real build events are accepted (keyed by ImportPath) and produce BUILD_FAILURE. Actual (suspected): parse error.
title: Suspected: native go-test parser refuses real build-fail/build-output events that carry ImportPath but no Package
